context_for_next_testing_agent: The Projects-module template editor lives at /projects → button data-testid='projects-templates-btn' → dialog data-testid='templates-dialog'. Variable chips use data-testid='var-token-{TOKEN}' (e.g. var-token-abreviaturas_medios_pago). The editor is a TipTap RichTextEditor (data-testid='project-tpl-editor'); use page.eval_on_selector("[data-testid='templates-dialog'] [contenteditable='true']", "el => el.innerHTML") to read content. To trigger an insertion, a template MUST be selected first (Editar button on a row); otherwise insertVar falls back to appending to templateForm.body which is also fine. Confirmed 49 chips total in 6 groups: Cliente(8), Cotización/Ventas(13), Proyecto(8), Infraestructura(5), Hardware(4), Despacho/Equipos/Reparación(11).
rca of the issue: N/A — the requested homologation of the Cotizaciones variable dictionary into the Projects template editor (TemplatesAdminDialog.VAR_GROUPS) is correctly implemented and working end-to-end. abreviaturas_medios_pago is visible, clickable, inserts the token, and shows a success toast.
